notes.title: new major update - welcome to the space station
notes.notes:
[p]The space station is a place where you can buy lots of [b]exotic[/b] new upgrades!!!
But unlike the shop, you [b]don't[/b] just [b]pay with coins[/b][/p][p]You only need to kill 5 aliens in the new level—how [b]hard[/b] can it be?[/p][p]The new gun introduces a familiar mechanic with a spicy twist—jumping.[/p][p]The new app, PortalMe, opens some[b] cool new strategies![/b][/p]
